E-STOP SENSE LOOP — Layer 2 input, fail-safe pull-up
Loss of signal is treated as

One latching mushroom button with two NC contacts. Contact 1 breaks the coil loop (power dies with no software involved); contact 2 is an isolated dry contact that tells the Pi what happened, so the event can be logged.

3 — Operating states and logged trigger sources
human clears the latch — never automatic
A clean exit (quit, SIGTERM) also de-energizes the rails, but writes no latch — only a genuine kill event blocks the next start.
Note: a hung Pi holds GPIO24 HIGH. The physical E-stop remains the only cut that does not depend on the Pi being alive.
